items.headline: NVIDIA and ServiceNow launch Project Arc

items.headline: Anthropic and Blackstone/Goldman Launch $1.5B JV
items.summary: Anthropic partners with Blackstone and Goldman Sachs for a $1.5B joint venture focused on industrial AI scaling.
items.technical_detail: JV focuses on hardware-software co-optimization for 100GW clusters.

items.headline: GPT-5.5 Instant Rollout: 1.1M Context and the Hallucination Paradox
items.summary: OpenAI makes GPT-5.5 Instant the default for ChatGPT. Features 1.1M context window but shows a 29.9% hallucination rate in ungrounded tests.
items.technical_detail: 29.9% hallucination rate in ungrounded reasoning; 1.1M context window.
